title: How Deterministic SAST and AI Security Agents Divide the Work: Coverage, Harness Policy and Cost in Snyk VulnBench 2.0
abstract: arXiv:2610.38617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We ask what AI coding agents and AI security harnesses find that deterministic static application security testing (SAST) does not, and what they miss that SAST catches. VulnBench 2.0 is a benchmark of 108 hand-curated, attacker-reachable vulnerabilities in 20 open-source web applications in Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Java; 62 flow across more than one file. A finding is credited only if it locates the vulnerability's attacker-controlled source and its dangerous sink, each within two lines. We evaluate nine productized configurations under one blind protocol: the Snyk Code static analyzer, Claude Code's /security-review with three model and effort settings (one with the Snyk MCP server), Codex Security with GPT-5.6 Luna, Terra and Sol, and the DeepSec scanner with two model backends. Snyk Code reached 82.4% macro recall (89 of 108) and Claude Code with Opus 5 at xhigh effort 79.3% (85 of 108); they disagree on 28 vulnerabili

translated_title: 确定性SAST与AI安全代理如何分工：Snyk VulnBench 2.0中的覆盖率、测试框架策略与成本
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.38617v1，交叉发布）：我们探讨AI编码代理和AI安全测试框架能够发现哪些确定性静态应用安全测试（SAST）无法发现的漏洞，以及它们会遗漏哪些SAST能够捕获的漏洞。VulnBench 2.0是一个基准测试集，包含20个开源Web应用（涵盖Go、JavaScript/TypeScript、Python和Java）中手工精选的108个攻击者可达漏洞，其中62个漏洞的污点传播流跨越多个文件。只有当发现结果定位到漏洞的攻击者可控输入源及其危险汇聚点，且每处误差不超过两行时，才被记为有效发现。我们在同一盲测协议下评估了九种产品化配置：Snyk Code静态分析器、三种模型与努力程度设置下的Claude Code /security-review（其中一种使用Snyk MCP服务器）、使用GPT-5.6 Luna、Terra和Sol的Codex Security，以及配备两种模型后端的DeepSec扫描器。Snyk Code达到82.4%的宏平均召回率（108个中的89个），Claude Code配合Opus 5在xhigh努力程度下达79.3%（108个中的85个）；二者在28个漏洞上结论不一致……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了包含20个开源Web应用中108个攻击者可达漏洞的VulnBench 2.0基准，并在统一盲测协议下对比评估确定性SAST与多种AI安全代理，揭示二者在漏洞覆盖率、定位策略和成本上的互补分工与分歧。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VulnBench 2.0, a benchmark of 108 attacker-reachable vulnerabilities across 20 open-source web applications, and under a single blind protocol compares deterministic SAST with multiple AI security agents, revealing how they complement and diverge in coverage, harness policy, and cost.
